label: Ruby

A01.remediation: Use Pundit / CanCanCan. Add `before_action :authenticate_user!` and ownership check (`@post.user == current_user`).

A02.remediation: Use `BCrypt::Password.create(pwd)` / `BCrypt::Password.create(string, cost: 12)`. Use `SecureRandom.hex(32)` for tokens. Move secrets to Rails credentials / Vault.

patterns.label: ERB template built from user input

A03.remediation: Pass argv lists to `Open3.capture3(cmd, *args)` (never a shell string). Use ActiveRecord (parameterised by default) instead of raw SQL. Never build an ERB template from `params` — a user-supplied template is remote code execution; render a fixed template with sanitised values.

A05.remediation: Set `config.middleware.insert_before 0, Rack::Cors` with explicit origins. Set `Rails.env = 'production'`.

A07.remediation: Use `user.authenticate(params[:password])` (has_secure_password + BCrypt). Enforce MFA via Devise :two_factor_authenticatable.

A08.remediation: Never `Marshal.load` untrusted bytes. Use JSON + schema validation.

A09.remediation: Use Rails.logger.info(...). Log auth + admin events with user id, IP, timestamp.
